page.overview:
Who is Becky Ann Reader?

Becky Ann Reader is a neighbor of the Simpson family.

She appeared in Simpsons Comics 94, in which she and her parents moved in near the Simpsons. Bart Simpson told Becky Ann and her parents about the new law requiring Springfield businesses to be open 24 hours. Lisa Simpson was confused and thought Bart was talking to her, but Bart explained that he was talking to "the Readers". This at first seemed to refer to the readers of the comic (due to the dialogue being written in all caps), but then it turned out to refer to the family.

Becky Ann was seen being cradled by her mother Emily as her father Bill introduced them. Then, the whole family went out of town for a few days and missed the chaos caused by the Springfield citizens losing their minds from sleeplessness. At the comic book store, Milhouse Van Houten told the whole family what had happened while the Readers were out of town.

Becky Ann is a baby girl with a small tuft of blonde hair on her head. Unlike most characters, she has a gap between her eyes, and unlike most female characters, she lacks visible eyelashes. She wears a pale pink onesie with buttons at the front. Category:Comic Book Only Characters Category:Babies
